jcvegc1v.baseName: Walplus 150 LED Bulb Lights Pre-lit Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 150 cm
jcvegc1v.variantName: Walplus 150 LED Bulb Lights Pre-lit Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 150 cm
jcvegc1v.sourceDescription: This artificial Christmas tree forms the striking centrepiece of your Christmas decorations, creating a unique Christmas atmosphere! This beautiful Christmas tree, made of PVC material, is very lifelike in its shape and appearance. It has extra thick branches, which make the tree seem even more realistic. All branches can be aligned which allows you to adjust the tree in the perfect form. The included metal stand provides your tree with optimal stability. The Christmas tree can be used again every year, making it a very economical choice compared to a real tree. Featuring energy-efficient LED lights, it lights up beautifully and creates a cosy holiday atmosphere. What's more, decorated with the beautiful peak and balls, this Xmas tree will be eye-catching in your home. Note: The product has a USB connector, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Product Specifications Tree colour: Green Shiny rose gold, matt rose gold and glitter rose gold Material: PVC, steel, plastic Total height: 150 cm Tree diameter: 80 cm LED string light length: 15 m Voltage: DC 5 V Power: 5 W With 680 tip Extra thick branches With 150 LEDs With USB connection Assembly required: Yes Delivery contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x LED string light 1 x Peak 20 x 3 cm ball 21 x 4 cm ball 20 x 6 cm ball This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd
